title: LOT-2291 Solder Defect Investigation
text: LOT-2291 showed a solder void defect rate of 3400 ppm against a 500 ppm limit. The defect was traced to operation OP-20 where reflow zone 4 ran 11 degC below profile. Containment covered LOT-2288 through LOT-2294; 0.4 pct of the affected units were reworked.
